claims.statement: FTAI (press release, 2026-07-22): J&F Power Systems, FTAI's joint venture with Jereh Group for packaging and distributing its Mod-1 aeroderivative gas turbine, signed a master supply agreement with an unnamed leading international cloud service provider and an initial USD 1.465 billion order for Mod-1 mobile gas turbine generator sets, delivered in batches through November 2027; settlement adjusts with performance, with downward adjustment capped at 10% of equipment value for lower power output. A new entrant's first large order with a contractual performance haircut — field performance has not been reported yet.

source_doc.title: FTAI Aviation 新聞稿（GlobeNewswire，2026-07-22；The Manila Times 轉載）：與杰瑞（Jereh Group）合資的 J&F Power Systems 跟一家國際雲端服務商簽 Mod-1 航改型燃機發電機組主供應合約，首張訂單 14.65 億美元、2027 年 11 月前分批交，性能不足最多扣 10%

sources.quote: (NASDAQ: FTAI) ("FTAI" or the "Company") today announced that J&F Power Systems LLC ("J&F"), FTAI's joint venture with Jereh Group for packaging and distribution of its Mod-1 aeroderivative gas turbine, has entered into a master gas turbine generator set supply agreement (the "Master Agreement") with a leading international cloud service provider (the "Customer") and signed an initial purchase order under the Master Agreement valued at $1.465 billion (the "Order").

Under the terms of the Order, J&F will supply Mod-1 mobile gas turbine generator sets supporting the Customer's power infrastructure buildout, with equipment to be delivered in batches through November 2027.

Final settlement amounts are subject to a performance adjustment mechanism, providing upward adjustments for equipment exceeding performance standards and downward adjustments, capped at 10% of the corresponding equipment's value for lower power output.
